notes_for_editor: Landforms says six-character Info codes such as FC1817 are NGS datasheet PIDs to be looked up with an NGS tool; it does not call them register numbers, so do not record FC 1817 as a state register number unless another source says so. Build date, design, height, staffing and access were not found in the sources read. Standing status rests on a 2014 list and a Landforms table with no per-tower check date; the page was last revised 8 January 2026. No photos found.
